title: Destination preconditions unasserted; CrossVersionMigrator NatSpec section C's 'uncheckable from here' claim is factually false
novelty: STILL-OPEN - in-place NARROWING of ss14l6. NO NEW FINGERPRINT. Do not close, do not re-file.
description: story-021 asserts 2 of 5 section-C preconditions. The leg that actually bites post-freeze is the destination POOL STATE: depositFor carries require(poolState[token] == PoolState.Active, 'StableStaker: pool not active'), so a destination already Migrating reverts every depositFor in the SECOND owner transaction, after the source is frozen. The phUSD-minter leg is a documentation defect only.
impact: None on assets. Source sits in Migrating with emissions frozen while the owner fixes the destination; userMigrate remains a permissionless self-exit throughout.

narrowedFromPriorReport.struck: F-03's claim that the precondition 'surfaces only at the first depositFor - i.e. after the source pool is already frozen' is WRONG for the MINTER leg. StableStakerV2._settle mints only if (user.amount > 0); a migrating user's destination position is fresh, so depositFor mints nothing and does not require the destination to be an authorized minter at all.
narrowedFromPriorReport.retained: The pool-state leg IS the post-freeze timing trap, mis-attributed by F-03 to the minter leg.

recommendation: Assert destination poolState == Active; and either add the two-hop minter probe (newStaker.phUSD() -> flax.authorizedMinters(newStaker).canMint && .mintVersion == flax.mintVersion()) or correct section C to say 'unguarded' without 'uncheckable'.
suppressionRefused: In-source NatSpec carries no suppression authority; the falsely-exhaustive claim RAISES severity rather than lowering it.
